english.note: Use this colloquial phrase when praising a performance, product, or result as leaving nothing to criticize.
Use this colloquial praise when saying that something is so good that there is nothing to criticise.

examples.traditional: 你今晚個表演真係冇得彈。

examples.english: The food at this restaurant tonight is impeccable; everyone ate every last bite.
examples.traditional: 今晚間餐廳啲菜真係冇得彈，大家食到清碟。
